name: tech-solutions-av2
description: AV2 - Tech Solutions em React + dois backends REST (Node.js e Java Spring Boot) com banco de dados

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:java: concurrently -n java,frontend -c red,green "cd backend-java && mvnw spring-boot:run" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
